plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Agricultural Communications and Journalism (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Select from ALED 100-499, FSTC 100-499, NUTR 100-499.
[grid1 fn2] Select from ANSC 100-499, ECCB 100-499, ENTO 100-499, HORT 100-499, PLPA 100-499, POSC 100-499, RWFM 100-499, SCSC 100-499.
[grid1 fn3] Select from AGCJ 311 , HMGT 336 , RWFM 336 , STAT 201-225, STAT 301-315.
[grid1 fn4] Select from any AGCJ 300-499 course not used elsewhere (except AGCJ 311 ).
[grid1 fn5] Agriculture emphasis area courses will be used to develop a cohesive career emphasis and are to be selected in consultation with an academic advisor. Select from any 100-499 course in the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (except AGSC 105 or FINP 235).
[grid1 fn6] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere (except AGCJ 100-499).
